name: v5.6.0
body:
## Scorecard Infrastructure Migration

v5.6.0 is the first Scorecard release since our hosted services moved! :tada:

The weekly batch scans and the REST API now run on [AboutCode Foundation](https://aboutcode.org)
infrastructure on AWS, operated in partnership with the Scorecard Steering Committee.

AboutCode is a public-benefit non-profit that already consumes Scorecard data and runs similar
large-scale data services, including [PurlDB](https://purldb.io) and
[VulnerableCode](https://public.vulnerablecode.io).

The full announcement is in [#5208](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5208).

What this means for you:

- **CLI and REST API users:** nothing changes. The API endpoint and the tooling are the same.
- **Scorecard Action users:** Upgrade to
  [v2.5.0](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard-action/releases/tag/v2.5.0) or later. Older versions
  pull images from `gcr.io`, which has been retired, and will fail.
- **Container images:** use `ghcr.io/ossf/scorecard`. Existing version tags were copied from
  `gcr.io/openssf/scorecard` with identical digests (v5.5.0 was already published to GHCR), so only
  the registry and namespace change:

  ```diff
  - gcr.io/openssf/scorecard:<tag>@sha256:<sha>
  + ghcr.io/ossf/scorecard:<tag>@sha256:<sha>
  ```

- **BigQuery dataset users:** the public dataset is no longer available.
- **Weekly scan inventory:** to add a repository to the weekly scans, follow
  [`ossf/scorecard-infra`'s contributing guide](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard-infra/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
  The pipeline and its project lists moved there.
- **Allstar users:** the hosted Allstar GitHub App has been retired. Allstar continues as a
  Scorecard subproject; see the [Allstar README](https://github.com/ossf/allstar) for self-hosting.

Report infrastructure problems at [ossf/scorecard-infra](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard-infra/issues).

Thank you to AboutCode Foundation for giving Scorecard a new home, and to everyone who reported
migration issues and helped other projects update.

## Action Required

- **Workflow checks now read YAML aliases, so Pinned-Dependencies may report more findings.** Steps
  reached through an alias (`uses: *anchor`, aliased `run:`) were previously skipped and are now
  checked by Pinned-Dependencies, Dangerous-Workflow and the other workflow-based checks. Each
  aliased step counts, so a repository that reuses unpinned actions this way and wasn't already at 0
  can lose score. by @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5287
- **Library users: `checks/fileparser` signatures changed.** Exported workflow helpers
  (`GetJobName`, `AnyJobsMatch`, `IsPackagingWorkflow` and others) now take Scorecard's own workflow
  types instead of `github.com/rhysd/actionlint` types, and some workflow parse error messages are
  worded differently. by @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5287
- **Library users: `cron/` has been removed.** `cron/data` and `cron/config` are no longer
  importable; the batch-scan pipeline now lives in `ossf/scorecard-infra` (see Scorecard
  Infrastructure Migration). by @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5210
- **Library users: Go 1.26.5 or later is required** (`go` directive raised from 1.26.0). by
  @justaugustus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5296

## General

- Release container images are built with Go 1.27.2. by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5310
- `--format=intoto` output is now serialized with `protojson`, so field names match the in-toto
  specification. by @puerco in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5225
- On Windows, file paths from GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps repositories now use forward slashes,
  matching other platforms. by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5153

### Azure DevOps

- Legacy Azure DevOps repository URLs are accepted and normalized to `dev.azure.com`. by @JamieMagee
  in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5128
- No workflow runs are returned, without querying every build, when the requested YAML pipeline
  doesn't exist. by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5129
- Language-aware checks fall back to all supported languages when language analytics are
  unavailable. by @JamieMagee in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5130
- A repository file larger than the archive extraction limit is now rejected instead of silently
  truncated. by @Sahana2524 in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5173

## Checks

### Packaging

- ko publishing workflows are detected with either `imjasonh/setup-ko` or `ko-build/setup-ko`;
  previously the matcher never fired. by @arcaven in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5134

### Pinned-Dependencies

- Actions referenced from the same repository with GitHub's `$/` prefix (for example `uses:
  $/.github/actions/example`) are treated like `./` local actions and no longer reported as
  unpinned. by @trask with @Kielek in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5191

### Vulnerabilities

- Python requirements files no longer trigger transitive dependency resolution, which could stall
  the check until it timed out. For library users, `clients.ExperimentalLocalOSVClient` no longer
  makes network requests for transitive resolution. osv-scanner is updated to v2.5.1. by
  @justaugustus with @adilalperenciftci in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5296
- Maven dependencies whose version is an unresolved build placeholder (for example
  `@project.version@` or `${revision}`) are no longer reported. by @justaugustus in
  https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5306

### Probes

- The `unsafeblock` probe also detects Java's `sun.misc.Unsafe` and `jdk.internal.misc.Unsafe`
  classes. by @thomasleplus in https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/4849

## Known Issues

- **GitLab: Vulnerabilities returns −1** for every GitLab repository
  ([#5056](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5056)). A fix is planned for v5.7.0
  ([#5180](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/pull/5180)).
- **Vulnerabilities: npm bundled dependencies are not checked.** Since the osv-scanner update,
  `package-lock.json` entries without a `resolved` URL, which includes bundled dependencies, are
  skipped when matching known vulnerabilities. This comes from osv-scalibr; we're following up
  upstream.
- **Pinned-Dependencies: findings reached through a YAML alias point at the anchor's line**, not the
  alias. How aliased steps are counted and attributed is tracked in
  [#5291](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5291).
